Details: Clean dataset must contain zero null or NaT values
Each row must represent a strictly unique order ID
Clean row count must match raw count minus duplicates and dropped unrecoverables
Order dates must fall within the 3-year study horizon
All quantities must be valid order line integers without entry errors
Discount must be within legitimate commercial discount bounds
Price and cost fields must be positive non-zero values
Sales must conform to quantity * unit_price * (1 - discount)
Profit must match sales * (1 - fee) - quantity * unit_cost (within cent rounding)
